scenes.title: Yenson's hut
text: Warmth, first. Then smoke, and the smell of fish, and driftwood popping in a fire.
An old man by the hearth looks up from the net he's mending.

extra.text: "Easy. The sea nearly kept you. Name's Yenson."
"Spring's in the copse, south of the shack. Follow the path."
"That boar's by the spring, more often than not. Go careful."
"Road's north, past the headland. Mind yourself out there."

choices.label: "What happened to me?"
choices.result: "Found you at the tide line this morning, tangled round a barrel. A trade boat went down off the point in the storm. You're the only one the sea gave back." He looks at you a moment longer. "Lucky. Or something."

choices.label: "Where am I?"
choices.result: "Loran. West coast. That light up the hill is Skelmed. Busiest port on this coast once. Now the king takes half of every catch, the roads have gone bad, and the merchants don't come."

choices.label: Eat the stew he offers
choices.result: Fish stew, mostly water and bones, and the best thing you've ever eaten.

choices.label: Thank him
choices.result: He waves it off. "Sea takes enough. Wasn't letting it have you as well."

choices.label: "What can I do for you?"
choices.result: "Can't keep you for nothing. Earn your keep a day or two, and I'll see you right for the road." He nods at a wooden bucket by the door. "Spring's in the copse south of here. Fill that, and we'll talk about supper."

choices.label: "Here's your water."
choices.result: He tips it into the pot and hands you a bowl of what was in there before. "Good. Fire wants feeding too. There's deadwood all over that copse. Three good armfuls."

choices.label: "Here's the firewood."
choices.result: He stacks it by the hearth, then goes quiet for a moment. "One more thing. There's a boar been tearing up the ground round the spring. Big brute, and bolder every week. I'm too old to go after it. You're not." He holds out his gutting knife, handle first. "Mind the tusks."

choices.label: "The boar's dead."
choices.result: Yenson whistles through his teeth. "Well. Didn't think you had it in you." He pushes a bundle across the floor: smoked boar from the last one he had, two heels of bread, a flint and a full waterskin, and forty coppers on top. "That's what I've got. Follow the coast road north to Skelmed. Garran the smith could use a pair of hands like yours."

scenes.title: Your bed
text: A pile of old sailcloth by the wall, still warm.

scenes.title: The hearth
text: Driftwood crackles in the hearth. A pot of stew hangs over it.

choices.label: Sit by the fire a while
choices.result: You sit and let the heat soak into you until your hands stop shaking.
